name_zh: 吴忠市青铜峡黄河大峡谷旅游区
address_zh: 宁夏吴忠市青铜峡市青铜峡镇
address_en: Qingtongxia Town, Qingtongxia City, Wuzhong City, Ningxia
intro_zh: 青铜峡黄河大峡谷旅游区位于宁夏回族自治区青铜峡市，景区面积126平方公里，世界灌溉工程遗产核心区，全国重点文物保护单位、全国科普教育基地。地处贺兰山下，黄河岸边，是宁夏黄河金岸旅游带的核心区，旅游区资源富集，历史文化源远流长，自然景观更是秀美奇绝。
intro_en: Qingtongxia Yellow River Grand Canyon Tourist Area is located in Qingtongxia City, Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. The scenic area covers an area of ​​126 square kilometers. It is a core area of ​​world irrigation engineering heritage, a national key cultural relics protection unit, and a national popular science education base. Located at the foot of Helan Mountain and on the bank of the Yellow River, it is the core area of ​​Ningxia's Yellow River Golden Bank tourist belt. The tourist area is rich in resources, has a long history and culture, and the natural landscape is even more beautiful.

foreign_visitors.note_zh: 中国 5A 景区通常对境外游客开放；部分景区需护照实名预约，出行前请以官网为准。
foreign_visitors.note_en: Most 5A sites admit international visitors; passport-based reservations may be required. Check the official site before travelling.
